hypothesis: For block 1 (input_rank=192), output-contribution topk improves channel selection by >=1 PPL vs current act_std x W_proj_norm
result_summary: All 4 criteria within 1 PPL (range 54.629-55.679). Best: S3 pure act_std=54.629, improvement=0.06 PPL. REFUTED.
interpretation: lstsq optimizes W_out globally for the selected K channels, compensating for non-ideal selection.
Channel ordering matters only if there is a quality cliff in the top-K selection. At K=512 (near-optimal), any reasonable subset works.
Pure weight norm (S4) is slightly worse (+1.0 PPL): the weight-only criterion occasionally selects channels with high W_proj norm but near-zero activation.
act_std (S3) alone matches the joint criterion (S1) — the W_proj_norm term adds no benefit at K=512.
